author: Twillion
name: CRT3D
description: 3DCRT+ is a flexible retro screen / post-processing shader for GDevelop 3D scenes (Three.js). Each effect - scanlines, anti-aliased shadow mask, screen bulge, black bezel border, brightness, camera blur, camera pixelation, ReShade-quality multi-tier bloom, chromatic aberration, roll, flicker, interlacing, and color grading - has its own on/off toggle (all off by default), so you switch on only what you want and the rest costs nothing. Blended by a master opacity. Tune it visually with the '3DCRT+ shader effect (manager)' behavior on an object in your scene (each effect is a checkbox), or drive it from events. Core scan-line shader ported from Timothy Lottes' public-domain CRT shader. Author: Twillion.
shortDescription: Flexible 3D retro/post shader: each effect (scanlines, bulge, mask, glitch, color...) toggles on/off. Editor-tunable.

eventsFunctions.name: RenderOverlayLayer
eventsFunctions.fullName: Render a 2D layer through the effect
eventsFunctions.description: Pull a 2D layer (e.g. a HUD) into the CRT pipeline. It is composited after colour grading but before the display effects (mask, grain, bezel), so it escapes the colour grade yet still gets mask/grain/bezel. The layer must sit BELOW the 3D layer in the layer list and be hidden in normal rendering.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Render 2D layer _PARAM1_ through the CRT effect

parameters.name: OverlayLayer
parameters.description: 2D layer to render through the effect
parameters.longDescription: Must be below the 3D layer in the editor's layer list, and otherwise hidden.

eventsFunctions.name: StopOverlayLayer
eventsFunctions.fullName: Stop rendering the 2D layer through the effect
eventsFunctions.description: Stop compositing the overlay layer through the CRT effect.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Stop rendering the 2D overlay layer through the CRT effect

eventsFunctions.description: Set the overlay-only fade to _PARAM1_ (0 = hidden, 1 = full).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.longDescription: 0..1. Default 1.

eventsFunctions.name: SetOverlayGlow
eventsFunctions.description: Phosphor bloom on the overlay (UI): bright UI elements glow like light on a tube, so the overlay reads as on-screen rather than pasted on. _PARAM1_ = strength (0 = off, ~0.3-0.8 typical).
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set CRT overlay UI glow to _PARAM1_

parameters.name: Value
parameters.longDescription: 0 = off. Around 0.3-0.8 looks like a lit tube. The UI itself stays sharp; only the glow is soft.

eventsFunctions.name: SetBloomThreshold

eventsFunctions.sentence: Set shader render bloom threshold to _PARAM1_

parameters.name: Value
parameters.longDescription: Brightness cutoff point (70 = 0.7). Lower = more bloom across midtones. Default: 70.

eventsFunctions.name: SetBloomRadius

eventsFunctions.sentence: Set shader render bloom blur radius to _PARAM1_

parameters.name: Value

eventsFunctions.description: Set shader render bloom soft-knee transition to _PARAM1_ (0-100, default 50 = 0.5). Smooths the boundary between glowing and non-glowing areas.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set shader render bloom soft knee to _PARAM1_

parameters.name: Value
parameters.longDescription: Transition softness curve. 0 = sharp cutoff, 100 = very soft ramp. Default: 50.

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Attach to a (usually invisible) manager object in your 3D scene. Each effect has a checkbox (all off by default) - tick the ones you want and set their values, right in the editor. You can also toggle and tune everything from events. One manager per scene.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: CRT3D
